```lean
theorem lg_target (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 1) : (x ^ 3 - 1) / (x - 1) = x ^ 2 + x + 1 := by
  have h1 : x ^ 3 - 1 = (x - 1) * (x ^ 2 + x + 1) := by ring
  rw [h1]
  have h2 : (x - 1) * (x ^ 2 + x + 1) / (x - 1) = x ^ 2 + x + 1 :=
    by rw [div_eq_mul_left_inv, mul_left_cancel hx]
  rw [h2]
```
